name: ai
title: Off-Grid AI
description: Query localized, non-networked Large Language Models for secure tactical data analysis.
notes: Heavy: needs real RAM and ideally a GPU. A small quantized model is a stretch on a Raspberry Pi's shared memory -- see ROADMAP.md Phase 1. This same Ollama engine is also shared by the 'education' module's Cloud9 AI helper -- it runs whenever either module is enabled, not just this one. `heavy_on_pi` drives install.sh's real ARM/Pi detection, added the same day this field was: defaults to 'no' on detected Pi-class hardware rather than everywhere, since Ollama's 4096m reservation alone can exceed a 4GB Pi's total RAM.
